newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toho Zinc to raise production capacity.
newsitem.headline: Toho Zinc to raise production capacity.

text.p: Toho Zinc Co Ltd said on Thursday that it expects to raise its zinc production capacity by 10,000 tonnes per year after completing renovation work at its Annaka refinery in central Japan.
"The completion of work at one of our zinc production facilities will enable us to produce up to about 149,200 tonnes of refined zinc per year," a company spokesman said.
He said the renovation would be completed in the near future but did not specify a date.
The company's current annual production capacity is 139,200 tonnes.
It said it plans to produce 131,800 tonnes of refined zinc in the business year to the end of March 1997.
The spokesman said it was not yet clear whether the company would raise output of refined zinc for 1997/98 given the renovation.
